title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - Intent
description: An Intent instance is the formal description of all expectations including requirements, goals, and constraints given to a technical system (TM Forum TMF921 Intent Management 5.0.0, OpenAPI component Intent; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Intent:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Intent'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'Intent' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:Intent:<tmfId>. unique identifier

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/description'. The description of the intent.

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/validFor'. A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

isBundle.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/isBundle'. isBundle determines whether an intent represents a single intent (false), or a bundle of intents(true).

priority.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/priority'. Can be used by intent owner to prioritize intents in an intent management system

statusChangeDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/statusChangeDate'. A date time( DateTime). The date that the entity status changed to the current one

context.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/context'. A string used to give a context to the intent

version.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/version'. A field that identifies the specific version of an instance of an intent.

intentSpecification.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/intentSpecification'. Entity reference schema to be use for all entityRef class.

characteristic.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/characteristic'. Describes a given characteristic of an object or entity through a name/value pair.

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/relatedParty'. RelatedParty reference. A related party defines party or party role or its reference, linked to a specific entity

attachment.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/attachment'. Attachments that may be of relevance to this intent, such as picture, document, media

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/name'. The name of the intent.

creationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/creationDate'. Date and time of the creation of this REST resource

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF921_Intent/blob/v5.0.0/TMF921_Intent_Management_v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Intent/properties/lastUpdate'. Date and time of the last update of this REST resource
